patthana10.7:3.1: na labbhati. na kusalaṃ na cittaṃ
patthana10.7:6.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na
patthana10.7:10.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na
patthana10.7:12.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na ajjhattikaṃ
patthana10.7:16.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na upādinnaṃ
patthana10.7:17.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika dvigocchakadukaṃ
